system.description:
You have studied a language or languages beyond your native tongue, able to speak, write and read them — whether an older vampire's lost childhood speech or a modern global tongue.

Choose one language for each level of Linguistics, each counting separately (e.g. Linguistics: Cantonese, Linguistics: German). Alternately you may study the underlying principles of Linguistics itself. Sign languages and dead scripts such as hieroglyphics also qualify; to converse in-play without truly speaking the tongue, players signal with an L-shape of finger and thumb.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
